level_reasons: Break My Fix finding 1: an input that breaks babelfish.language.Language.fromietf

summary.text: The verifier reproduced the original issue and found no regressions, but Break My Fix found an input that breaks the fixed code: Language.fromietf('İ') raises LanguageReverseError: 'i̇'. Look first at how fromietf handles case conversion of non-ASCII input such as the Turkish dotted capital I, since lowercasing it yields a two-character string that the reverse lookup rejects; note also that the f…
